notes: Both אֲשֶׁר ... לְ clauses are read under rule 49's belonging clause, with *belonged* joining the preposition and heading on *to*.

The copula *was* at t023 goes to the prepositional predicate אֶל־פְּנֵי rather than to the subject אַתִּיק (rules 20, 49); the unit is discontinuous under rule 25 because English writes the copula before the subject.
The italic *cubits* at t005 completes the numeral's English phrase and is read under rule 31 rather than as an `added` supply, the head staying on *twenty*.
